fit_mano_model_to_joints: fit the MANO hand model to 3D joint locations using MANOFitter.fit_joints with pose and shape parameters
register_two_point_clouds: register two point clouds by rigid transformation using register_pcs to compute the target-to-source transform
extract_palm_joints: extract the 6 palm joints (root plus base of all 5 fingers) from a joint array using get_palm_joints
create_mano_param_dict: create a default MANO parameter dictionary with zero-initialized pose, betas, and transformation values using mano_param_dict
load_mano_model_for_fitting: load LEFT and RIGHT MANO model pickle files via the MANOFitter class constructor for hand mesh fitting
